headline: 34 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Timber Fire in CA, threatening 211 structures.

active_threats.name: Timber
active_threats.narrative: The Timber Fire in Monterey County, CA has burned 25,407 acres and is 97% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **211 structures threatened**. 148 personnel are assigned. Winds are expected to stay comparatively light over the next 24 hours (gusts near 13 mph), which should limit further wind-driven spread for now. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind direction (S, blowing toward the N) favors pushing the fire toward Carmel Valley Village CDP, 20 miles away.
